result:
I implemented `Array.prototype.reverse` in `crates/kahvi-builtins/src/array/prototype_reverse.rs`, with each spec step kept as a comment above its code. The build, clippy and formatting are clean, and 32 of 36 test262 runs under `built-ins/Array/prototype/reverse/` pass.

The 4 remaining runs fail with not-implemented errors from engine features outside my file: `Reflect.get` (2 runs, length-exceeding-integer-limit-with-proxy) and `BigInt` (2 runs, resizable-buffer). They don't come from the reverse logic, so the "every test passes" condition can't be met without changes outside this ticket's scope.

BLOCKED: `Reflect.get` (needed by length-exceeding-integer-limit-with-proxy.js) and `BigInt` (needed by resizable-buffer.js) are not implemented in the engine.
